clues.text: Pharaoh dreamed he stood beside it and watched seven sleek, well-fed cows come up to graze among the reeds.
In Egypt, Pharaoh commanded his people to throw every son born to the Hebrews into it.
A Levite mother coated a papyrus basket with tar and set her baby among the reeds on its bank.
Pharaoh's daughter went down to bathe in it and saw a basket among the reeds.
In front of Pharaoh and his officials, Aaron raised the staff and struck its water, turning it to blood.
Through Moses, God warned Pharaoh it would teem with frogs that would climb into his palace and onto his bed.
God spoke against Pharaoh, the great monster lying among his rivers, who boasted that he had made this himself.

taken: God warned Pharaoh these would come into his palace, onto his bed, and into ovens and kneading bowls.
